title: Differentially Private Policy Optimization in Linear MDPs with Adversarial Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2611.33469v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) in personalized services often relies on sensitive interaction data. Motivated by the need to protect these data, we study differentially private (DP) policy optimization in episodic linear Markov decision processes (MDPs) with unknown transitions and adaptive adversarial linear rewards under full-information feedback. This setting poses two key challenges: past trajectories are repeatedly reused for policy evaluation, and reward choices may depend on previously released private statistics. The proposed algorithm combines batched proximal policy optimization (PPO) updates with optimistic policy evaluation, using private regression statistics and reward estimates to protect both trajectories and reward functions under joint differential privacy (JDP). translated_title: 具有对抗性奖励的线性马尔可夫决策过程中的差分隐私策略优化
translated_abstract: 个性化服务中的强化学习（RL）通常依赖于敏感的交互数据。出于保护这些数据的需求，我们研究了在全信息反馈下、具有未知转移和自适应对抗性线性奖励的分段式线性马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中的差分隐私（DP）策略优化。这一设定带来了两个关键挑战：过去的轨迹会被重复用于策略评估，且奖励的选择可能依赖于先前发布的私有统计量。所提出的算法将批量化的近端策略优化（PPO）更新与乐观策略评估相结合，利用私有回归统计量和奖励估计，在联合差分隐私（JDP）下同时保护轨迹和奖励函数。在所有其他参数固定的情况下，我们的高概率遗憾界保留了关于回合数的主要 $\widetilde{O}\left(K^{3/4}\right)$ 依赖关系。
tldr: 本文针对具有未知转移和自适应对抗性奖励的线性MDP，提出了一种结合批量化PPO与乐观策略评估的差分隐私策略优化算法，在联合差分隐私下同时保护轨迹与奖励数据，并实现了保留 $\widetilde{O}\left(K^{3/4}\right)$ 主导项的高概率遗憾界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a differentially private policy optimization algorithm for episodic linear MDPs with unknown transitions and adaptive adversarial rewards, which combines batched PPO updates with optimistic policy evaluation under joint differential privacy to protect both trajectories and reward functions, while achieving a high-probability regret bound retaining the leading $\widetilde{O}\left(K^{3/4}\right)$ dependence.
